A command-line interface for Asana, inspired by GitHub's gh.

Manage tasks, projects, sections, and workspaces from your terminal.
Supports both human-readable output and JSON for automation.

Quick start:
  asana auth login              # Authenticate with your token
  asana config set workspace "My Workspace"
  asana task list -p "Project"  # List tasks in a project
  asana task create "New task"  # Create a task

Get a Personal Access Token at: https://app.asana.com/0/my-apps

Usage:
  asana [command]

Available Commands:
  attachment         Manage task attachments
  auth               Manage authentication
  completion         Generate shell completion script
  config             Manage configuration
  custom-field       Manage custom fields
  goal               Manage goals
  help               Help about any command
  login              Log in to Asana (shortcut for 'auth login')
  portfolio          Manage portfolios
  project            Manage projects
  section            Manage sections
  tag                Manage tags
  task               Manage tasks
  team               Manage teams
  update             Update asana-cli to the latest version
  user               Manage users
  version            Print version information
  workspace          Manage workspaces

Flags:
      --config string     Path to the config file
      --dry-run           Preview changes without performing them
  -h, --help              help for asana
      --include-meta      Wrap machine output as {data, meta} (commands that expose request metadata)
      --jq string         Transform stable JSON output with a jq expression (commands with machine output)
      --json              Output stable JSON instead of the human view
      --no-ansi           Disable all ANSI/control sequences in human output
      --no-color          Disable color in human output
      --no-pager          Never use a pager for long human output
      --no-prompt         Never block on an interactive prompt
      --plain             Print unstyled, copy-safe text (commands with human output)
      --quiet             Suppress non-essential output
      --template string   Render stable JSON output through a Go text/template (commands with machine output)
  -v, --version           version for asana

Use "asana [command] --help" for more information about a command.
